purpose: Start from the Midwest Snacks post. Maybe somebody there has the snacks my bench is missing.

pages.title: Midwest Snacks
pages.reaction: A thread about fried ranch, chili gruel and Kiev-adjacent horrors. No fish snacks, no esoteric languages, just a comment section yelling about ranch. Nice for a laugh, nothing here fills the bench gap.

pages.title: A chair for Gamers™️
pages.reaction: A gaming chair with a urinal bucket and a vacuum hose, sold as furniture. The commenters did the real engineering review: the pipe is in the wrong place and the hole is off-centre. I cannot weld either, so I respect the honesty. Not my world's snacks, but the thread was funny. Following the Midwest Snacks link to keep the trip …
